entities.name: Thacker Pass lithium processing plant (acid leach & neutralization, with captive sulfuric acid plant)

entities.short: Integrated clay processing plant at the Thacker Pass claystone (McDermitt caldera) deposit. Includes a captive sulfur-burning sulfuric acid plant (~3,000 tpd design, MECS technology) generating steam/power. EPC by Bechtel. entities.short: Umicore's ultra-high-temperature (UHT) Li-ion battery recycling smelter at Hoboken, Antwerp province, Belgium. Produces a Co/Ni/Cu alloy plus a Li-Al-Si-Ca-Mn-O slag; the slag is the lithium-bearing feed to Umicore's hydrometallurgical Li recovery flowsheet (H2SO4 leach -> CaO purification -> Na2CO3 -> evaporative crystallization -> Li2CO3, ~98% purity per LiBRi-derived process).
